Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at

the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of NTPC SAIL Power Company Ltd payable at SECTOR-1 BRANCH, BHILAI, IFSC Code:- SBIN0000330 . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name NTPC SAIL POWER COMPANY LIMITED Account No. 40631342564 IFSC Code SBIN0000691 Bank Name STATE BANK OF INDIA Branch address NEW DELHI MAIN BRANCH (00691) . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

Delivery - Within 3 months from the Date of PO. Bid Participation Criteria The bidder shall meet all the following criteria and enclose the supporting documents with the bid. Bids not meeting these criteria are liable to be rejected. 1. If the bidder claims to be the OEM of the main Instrument, it shall enclose a declaration on its lette rhead that it is the original equipment manufacturer of the offered model. “OR” In case the bid is offered by a Bidder other than the manufacturer of the main instrument, the Bidd er must submit a valid Bid specific letter of authorisation from the manufacturer/OEM for the produ ct quoted to NSPCL. Also, the bidder should furnish an undertaking from the manufacturer towards successful performance of the contract, including warranty and subsequent maintenance, supply o f spares and services in the event of award of contract in their favour. 2. The Manufacturer (OEM)/supplier must have supplied at least three of the similar kind of machines with the above-mentioned similar technical specifications in any Govt/ PSU Power Generating com pany / Forensic Science Universities/ PSUs or to some Government laboratory for similar applicatio n in India. The vendor/OEM should submit copy of proof of installation of the ED-XRF along with cop y of reference POs 3. The manufacturer should have an authorised service centre in India for the supplied system, or th e manufacturer should have its direct office in India for after-sales support and proper set-up to su pport customers for their applications, whenever required. The availability of spares should be ens ured for at least 10 years from the date of successful commissioning. An undertaking to this effect shall be submitted (Issued from OEM) along with the bid. Note: "Additional Specifications, Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms & Conditions, Attachments (i f any) along with Tender specifications shall be deemed unconditionally accepted by bidders, unless there are specific representation/s and clarification/s prior to bid submission in GeM po rtal". . 8.
